# StatPilot

> StatPilot (https://statpilot.mom) is a Google Analytics 4 dashboard for people who run several websites. You sign in with Google once; it finds every GA4 property your Google account can access and shows them all on one screen, with no per-site setup. It reads GA4 only (read-only access), not Google Ads, Facebook or Stripe. StatPilot is in early access: sign-in is open to invited testers for now, free for up to 3 properties. Invites: hello@dizid.com. Made by Dizid Web Development (https://dizid.com).

## How it works
- Sign-in: Google OAuth with the read-only Analytics scope; properties are discovered automatically through the Google Analytics APIs.
- Data: pulled from the GA4 Data API per property; cached in the browser, not stored in a database.
- Access: early access by invite (Google's OAuth testing mode) until Google verifies the app.

## Guides
- [GA4 Cross-Domain Measurement vs Separate Properties for Several Sites](https://statpilot.mom/blog/ga4-cross-domain-vs-separate-properties/): one property with cross-domain measurement, one property per site, or several streams in one property; what each does to users and sessions, referrals between your own sites, reporting, access and limits, with a decision table.
- [GA4 Data Retention Settings: 2 vs 14 Months and What They Affect](https://statpilot.mom/blog/ga4-data-retention-settings/): the 2 and 14 month options (up to 50 months on 360), why only explorations and funnel reports are affected, reset on new activity, why to set it right away, and checking many properties with the Admin API.
- [Handing a GA4 Property to a Client (or Taking One Over)](https://statpilot.mom/blog/ga4-property-handover-client/): who should own a client's property, moving a property between accounts (roles needed, what moves, what blocks it), sharing access instead, and stepping back after the handover.
- [Comparing Traffic Across Sites in GA4: Which Metrics to Use](https://statpilot.mom/blog/compare-traffic-across-sites-ga4/): users vs sessions, engagement rate vs bounce rate, key events, and the settings (time zone, filters, consent) that skew cross-site comparisons.
- [GA4 Numbers Don't Match? Thresholds, (other) Row and Sampling](https://statpilot.mom/blog/ga4-numbers-differ-thresholds-other-row/): why reports, explorations, the Data API and Data Studio show different numbers, and how to compare like with like.
- [GA4 Traffic Dropped? How to Find the Cause](https://statpilot.mom/blog/ga4-traffic-drop-find-the-cause/): tracking gap or real drop: data freshness, Realtime and DebugView, consent mode, data filters, time zone, change history and annotations; then Search Console, Google's ranking updates (incl. the November 2026 core update) and Google Trends.
- [GA4 Data API Quotas: Tokens and Limits for Multi-Site Dashboards](https://statpilot.mom/blog/ga4-data-api-quotas-multi-site/): Google's standard vs 360 token limits per property (day, hour, per project), what a request costs, worked sums for many sites, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and how to stay inside.
- [GA4 Property Not Showing? How to Check and Fix Access](https://statpilot.mom/blog/ga4-property-not-showing-access/): account vs property access, GA4 roles, the common reasons a property is missing (wrong Google account, another organization, old Universal Analytics) and how to grant access.
- [GA4 Roll-Up Properties: How to Combine Properties Without 360](https://statpilot.mom/blog/ga4-roll-up-properties-without-360/): roll-up properties and subproperties are Analytics 360 features; four options without 360 (switching properties, Data Studio, the Data API, a multi-property dashboard).
- [Multiple GA4 Properties in Looker Studio (Now Data Studio)](https://statpilot.mom/blog/ga4-multiple-properties-looker-studio/): several GA4 properties in one report, blends of up to 5 sources, and GA4 quota errors with Google's numbers.
- [GA4 Multi-Property Dashboard: Your Options Compared](https://statpilot.mom/blog/ga4-multi-property-dashboard-comparison-2026/): AgencyAnalytics, Databox, DashThis, AnalyticsPortfolio and StatPilot compared.
